name: Haus Christine
beschreibung:
Sunnily and idyllically set in Leutasch, Haus Christine welcomes outdoor lovers with comfortably furnished apartments. Expansive views of the Wetterstein mountain range invite complete relaxation.

Olympic cross-country ski trails, alpine hiking in the Gaistal valley, and Seefeld are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Christine in Leutasch provides cosy holiday apartments and alpine quietude in the Leutasch valley.
